non_evidence_disclaimer: The symmetric m=3 saddle, an approximate symmetric cap hit, the existence of the first reflection-odd Hessian block, and exploratory local signs were inspected before this file was written. This manifest freezes the production mutation and audit contract; it does not erase that feasibility knowledge or count as evidence.

amendment.trigger: The first fail-closed production run showed that exact delta-zero Morse whitening makes the positive and negative blocks internally degenerate, so individual nonzero-delta eigendirections cannot be continuously anchored to unique delta-zero eigenvectors.
amendment.correction: Transport the positive and negative spectral subspaces, which are the continuous invariant objects, by orthogonal Procrustes alignment to the frozen delta-zero signed coordinate subspaces. Build the launch frame with the inverse positive square root of the Hessian restricted to each aligned signed subspace.
amendment.epistemic_status: Transparent post-failure correction of an ill-posed frame-gauge requirement; not a new scientific result and not permission to alter the frozen action, source, metric, cap, delta grid, or promotion boundary.

purpose: Test whether the Phase39 local cap-piece witness survives the first added reflection-odd history sector and a signed endpoint-asymmetry probe, without promoting any local result to a bounded-chain or global Picard-Lefschetz coefficient.

model.name: three-segment midpoint Starobinsky minisuperspace configuration regulator

base_boundary.source: Phase25 benchmark inherited without tuning to the Phase40 intersection

model.analytic_domain: C^4 times C-star in T; T=0 is excluded as an action pole

signed_endpoint_mutation.time_reflection: delta maps to -delta while node 1 maps to node 2 and node 2 maps to node 1
signed_endpoint_mutation.probe_interpretation: The real endpoint mutation is a symmetry probe, not a physical time arrow, CPT-breaking source, or non-Stokes regulator.

reflection_and_mode_conventions.orientation_rule: The declared mode basis is oriented to positive determinant relative to the frozen nodal order; any raw sign from another order must be corrected before comparison.

saddle_protocol.seed_source: the symmetric m=3 feasibility saddle continued along the fixed signed delta grid

gradient_metric.type: one constant positive Hermitian m=3 delta-zero Morse-whitened metric
gradient_metric.construction: Solve the delta=0 saddle, diagonalize its real symmetric H_w=O*Lambda*O^T with det(O)=+1, and set L_0=O*diag(abs(Lambda)^(-1/2)); use w=w_saddle(delta)+L_0*xi and the Euclidean Hermitian metric in xi for every delta.
gradient_metric.global_constancy: L_0 is held fixed across the entire signed delta grid and along every trajectory; it is not re-whitened at nonzero delta or recomputed along a flow.

upward_chart.local_takagi_frame: At each continued saddle, compute the positive and negative spectral subspaces of L_0^T H_w L_0, align each whole signed subspace to its frozen delta-zero coordinate subspace by orthogonal Procrustes transport, and use the inverse positive square root of the Hessian restricted to that aligned subspace together with the e^{-S} real/imaginary Takagi phases. Individual eigendirections inside the exactly degenerate delta-zero signed blocks are not treated as invariant.
upward_chart.chart: omega(u)=normalize(omega_center+B*u), u in R^4, with B an oriented orthonormal tangent basis satisfying det[B,omega_center]=+1

declared_original_cycle_candidate.status: finite-window Gaussian-lift chain candidate, not a derived physical original relative cycle
declared_original_cycle_candidate.oriented_lapse_path: [-R,-r] followed by N=r*exp(i*theta), theta from -pi to 0, followed by [r,R]
declared_original_cycle_candidate.field_anchor: For node j=1,2 use the saddle-independent linear interpolation qbar_j=(1-j/3)q_L+(j/3)q_R.
declared_original_cycle_candidate.orientation_note: Neither the Phase32 momentum-times-configuration normalization nor the Phase39 three-complex-dimensional raw sign is inherited. Phase40 declares and audits its own five-complex-dimensional nodal and mode orientations.

intersection_protocol.local_orientation_sign: sign det_R[V_Gamma,V_K] in the declared interleaved ambient order
intersection_protocol.root_jacobian_warning: the solver residual Jacobian [V_Gamma,-V_K] differs by (-1)^5=-1 from the requested oriented-intersection determinant
required_controls: column-normalized determinant sign and singular spectrum
variational tangent versus independent finite-difference residual Jacobian

exact: one symbolic S_3 scalar produces every gradient and Hessian
S_3 is holomorphic for T nonzero and meromorphic at T=0
action, gradient, and Hessian obey signed reflection covariance
the DST-I basis separates the delta-zero even and odd Hessian blocks
Gamma and K frames have the declared middle dimension and odd root-Jacobian parity
flow identities make Re(S) nonincreasing and Im(S) constant
incomplete chain, census, Stokes, or end data force every global integer output to null
numerical: continued delta-grid saddles satisfy all five joint equations and remain nondegenerate
signed saddles, actions, Hessians, odd amplitudes, and local candidates match under reflection
the declared phi-source produces a nonzero sign-reversing tracked odd response
full ten-real-dimensional local candidates are resolved at delta zero and the two primary signed endpoints
direct signs, singular gaps, tangent transport, finite-difference Jacobians, orientation mutations, and initial-radius controls are recorded
the odd-mode clamp is distinguished from the full chart rather than treated as equivalent

promotion_boundary: A successful run may support only one frozen m=3, phi-source, local cap-piece witness with the first reflection-odd history sector and signed endpoint mutation included. It cannot establish m=4 agreement, cutoff convergence, the physical original cycle, the entire bounded-chain pairing, a complete upward-cycle census, a global PL coefficient, Gate 1 closure, BFV/Pfaffian/Pin data, a conserved spinorial charge, SUSY breaking, or quantum gravity.
